entries.en: A Salvadoran photographer brought a box of family portraits to the community exhibition.
entries.zh: 一位萨尔瓦多摄影师带了一盒家庭肖像照来参加社区展览。

entries.en: Our paternal aunt sent a postcard from Queensland but forgot to include her new address.
entries.zh: 我们的姑姑从昆士兰寄来一张明信片，却忘了附上新地址。

entries.en: Mr Leonardo brought back the borrowed ladder before the neighbours began painting their fence.
entries.zh: 李奥纳多先生在邻居们开始给围栏刷漆之前，送回了借来的梯子。

entries.en: She chose an Aegean coastal scene for the cover of her travel notebook.
entries.zh: 她选了一张爱琴海沿岸景色的图片，作为旅行笔记本的封面。

entries.en: The biography of Muir had several loose pages, which the librarian repaired before lending it.
entries.zh: 那本缪尔传记有几页松脱了，图书管理员修好后才把它借出。

entries.en: We arrived in Christchurch with wet coats and a suitcase that would no longer close.
entries.zh: 我们抵达克赖斯特彻奇时，外套都湿了，还有一个已经合不上的行李箱。

entries.en: Her cousin kept the letters from Louisiana in a biscuit tin under the desk.
entries.zh: 她的堂表亲把来自路易斯安那的信放在书桌下的饼干盒里。

entries.en: The seminar compared a Freudian reading of the novel with an interpretation focused on social class.
entries.zh: 研讨课把对这部小说的弗洛伊德学说式解读，与侧重社会阶层的解读作了比较。

entries.en: The student revised the paragraph explaining the Darwinian argument before handing in her essay.
entries.zh: 那位学生修改了说明达尔文学说论点的段落，然后才交上论文。

entries.en: Olivier carried the folded chairs upstairs while his flatmate cleared space in the kitchen.
entries.zh: 奥利维尔把折叠椅搬上楼时，他的室友正在厨房腾地方。

entries.en: The astronomy tutor asked us to find Norma on a chart before discussing the photograph.
entries.zh: 天文学辅导老师让我们先在星图上找到矩尺座，再讨论那张照片。

entries.en: The parcel from Maryland contained two knitted scarves and a note written in pencil.
entries.zh: 来自马里兰州的包裹里有两条针织围巾，还有一张用铅笔写的便条。

entries.en: Barrie offered to mend the gate if we could find the missing hinges.
entries.zh: 巴里说，只要我们能找到丢失的铰链，他就愿意修好那扇门。

entries.en: The linguistics class compared Germanic verb forms using examples from two old grammar books.
entries.zh: 语言学课用两本旧语法书中的例子，比较了日耳曼语的动词形式。

entries.en: We stopped beside the Danube to sketch the boats before the afternoon rain began.
entries.zh: 下午下雨之前，我们在多瑙河边停下来，画那些船的速写。

entries.en: The history teacher asked us to explain how the novel condemns Nazism rather than merely describing it.
entries.zh: 历史老师让我们说明，这部小说是怎样谴责纳粹主义，而不只是描述它的。

entries.meaningZh: 信奉基督教的国家整体（旧时用语）
entries.en: Her history essay compared rival kingdoms within medieval Christendom without treating them as a single state.
entries.zh: 她的历史论文比较了中世纪基督教世界中相互竞争的王国，并没有把它们当作一个国家。

entries.meaningZh: 费舍尔（此处指化学家埃米尔·费舍尔）
entries.en: The archive displayed a portrait of Emil Fischer beside the catalogue of its chemistry collection.
entries.zh: 档案馆在化学藏品目录旁展出了一幅埃米尔·费舍尔的肖像。

entries.en: In the historical novel, the farmer buys a Galloway after inspecting its hooves and saddle.
entries.zh: 在那部历史小说里，农夫查看了马蹄和马鞍后，买下了一匹盖勒韦马。

entries.en: Her travel diary included a sketch made beside the Congo while the boat was being repaired.
entries.zh: 她的旅行日记里有一幅速写，是修船期间在刚果河边画的。

entries.en: Lennon saved the last slice of cake for his brother, who was still at work.
entries.zh: 列侬把最后一块蛋糕留给了还在工作的兄弟。

entries.en: Burt checked every coat pocket before finding the spare key inside a gardening glove.
entries.zh: 伯特翻遍了每件外套的口袋，最后在一只园艺手套里找到了备用钥匙。

entries.en: We packed the drawings from Dresden between two boards to keep their corners flat.
entries.zh: 我们把来自德累斯顿的画夹在两块板之间，以免画角卷起来。

entries.en: Christmastime brought extra customers to the bakery, so we opened a second counter.
entries.zh: 圣诞节期间，面包店的顾客增多了，于是我们增设了一个柜台。

entries.en: The illustrator placed Cynthia above the sleeping village in her drawing of the moon goddess.
entries.zh: 插画师在描绘月亮女神的画中，把辛西娅画在沉睡的村庄上方。

entries.en: Mrs Whitehead folded the clean sheets while we carried the blankets to the guest room.
entries.zh: 怀特黑德太太叠着干净床单，我们则把毯子搬进客房。

entries.en: The Malaysian student brought photographs she had taken to illustrate the story she had written.
entries.zh: 那位马来西亚学生带来了自己拍的照片，为她写的故事配图。

entries.en: Merlin chicks appeared in the wildlife photograph that she chose for the school display.
entries.zh: 她选作学校展品的野生动物照片上有几只灰背隼幼鸟。

entries.en: A storm delayed our ferry to Newfoundland, leaving us another evening to explore the harbour.
entries.zh: 暴风雨延误了我们去纽芬兰岛的渡船，让我们又多了一个傍晚逛港口。

entries.en: The address in Genoa was written so faintly that we needed a magnifying glass.
entries.zh: 那个热那亚地址写得太淡了，我们得用放大镜才看得清。

entries.en: His friends in Seattle sent a recording of their rehearsal instead of a birthday card.
entries.zh: 他在西雅图的朋友们寄来了一段排练录音，而不是生日贺卡。

entries.en: We left our luggage at the hotel in Antwerp and went out to buy sketchbooks.
entries.zh: 我们把行李留在安特卫普的旅馆里，出去买速写本。

entries.en: Mr Robbins counted the returned tools, locked the workshop and finished work for the day.
entries.zh: 罗宾斯先生数了数归还的工具，然后锁上车间，结束了一天的工作。

entries.en: Gainsborough returned the borrowed sewing machine with a new packet of needles tucked inside its case.
entries.zh: 盖恩斯伯勒归还了借来的缝纫机，机箱里还塞着一包新针。

entries.en: Frazer brought an extra blanket because the room above the garage was often cold.
entries.zh: 弗雷泽多带了一条毯子，因为车库楼上的房间常常很冷。

entries.en: The Macaulay family kept a spare pair of boots beside the back door.
entries.zh: 麦考利一家在后门旁放着一双备用靴子。

entries.en: The book about Andersen was returned with a pressed flower between its final pages.
entries.zh: 那本介绍安徒生的书归还时，最后几页之间夹着一朵压干的花。

entries.en: In the novel, an Aztec helps the travelling potter repair a broken cart.
entries.zh: 在那部小说里，一位阿兹特克人帮助行路的陶工修好了一辆坏掉的车。

entries.en: Mrs Hogg left the repaired jacket on a chair beside the sewing table.
entries.zh: 霍格太太把修补好的夹克放在缝纫台旁的椅子上。

entries.meaningZh: 斯普林菲尔德（此处指伊利诺斯州城市）
entries.en: The reunion in Springfield, Illinois, was postponed when several relatives missed their connecting trains.
entries.zh: 伊利诺斯州斯普林菲尔德的那场聚会推迟了，因为几位亲戚没赶上换乘的火车。

entries.en: Mr Gillespie offered to carry the damaged chair upstairs after we removed its loose cushion.
entries.zh: 我们取下松动的坐垫后，吉莱斯皮先生主动提出把那把坏椅子搬上楼。

entries.en: The invitation from Denver arrived after we had already booked our tickets elsewhere.
entries.zh: 来自丹佛的邀请到达时，我们已经订好了去别处的票。

entries.en: The fictional debate pairs a committed Thatcherite with a student who challenges every economic assumption.
entries.zh: 这场虚构的辩论让一位坚定的撒切尔支持者，与一名质疑每项经济假设的学生交锋。

entries.en: Her paternal grandmother's journey through the Balkans filled three notebooks with sketches, expenses and unfinished letters.
entries.zh: 她祖母穿行巴尔干半岛地区的旅途，留下了三本记有速写、开销和未写完书信的笔记。

entries.en: Sheridan put his muddy boots outside before helping us prepare the spare bedroom.
entries.zh: 谢里丹先把沾泥的靴子放在外面，然后帮我们收拾备用卧室。

entries.meaningZh: 诺森伯里亚（历史王国名）
entries.en: The historical novel follows a messenger carrying a damaged letter through Northumbria.
entries.zh: 那部历史小说讲述了一名信使携带一封破损的信，穿越诺森伯里亚的经历。

entries.en: The host rebuked a guest who had called the German visitor a Hun.
entries.zh: 主人训斥了一位用“德国佬”辱骂那名德国来客的客人。

entries.en: Mrs Gallup brought back our mixing bowl with a loaf of bread wrapped inside.
entries.zh: 盖洛普太太送回了我们的搅拌碗，里面包着一条面包。

entries.en: McCartney lent his bicycle to a neighbour whose car was still being repaired.
entries.zh: 麦卡特尼把自行车借给了一位车还在修理中的邻居。

entries.en: We found the tickets for Nuremberg in a pocket of last winter's coat.
entries.zh: 我们在去年冬天穿的外套口袋里，找到了去纽伦堡的票。

entries.en: The Ricardo family lent us their folding table for the weekend craft fair.
entries.zh: 里卡多一家把折叠桌借给我们，用于周末的手工艺品集市。

entries.en: The reading group discussed a chapter of Isaiah before comparing notes on the two translations.
entries.zh: 读书小组先讨论了《以赛亚书》中的一章，然后交流对两种译本的笔记。

entries.en: She kept the ferry ticket from Java beside the photographs in her travel album.
entries.zh: 她把从爪哇岛出发的渡船票，和照片一起保存在旅行相册里。

entries.en: The historian questioned the fictional narrator's defence of Stalinist policies during the seminar.
entries.zh: 研讨课上，历史学家质疑了那位虚构叙述者对斯大林主义政策的辩护。

entries.en: The documentary challenged the narrator's sweeping claims about Slavic customs instead of simply repeating them.
entries.zh: 那部纪录片质疑了叙述者对斯拉夫人习俗的笼统说法，而不是简单照搬。

entries.en: Ives carried the last basket of washing indoors just as rain began falling on the washing line.
entries.zh: 晾衣绳上刚开始落下雨点，艾夫斯就把最后一篮衣物搬进了屋。

entries.en: She found an old PDA in the drawer, but its battery would no longer charge.
entries.zh: 她在抽屉里找到一台旧的个人数字助手，但它的电池已经充不进电了。

entries.en: Ambrose brought a torch so that we could check the loft before sunset.
entries.zh: 安布罗斯带来了一只手电筒，好让我们在日落前检查阁楼。

entries.en: The old diary described a journey through Zaire and included a carefully folded map.
entries.zh: 那本旧日记描写了一趟穿越扎伊尔的旅行，里面还夹着一张仔细折好的地图。

entries.en: The letters from Minnesota were tied together with the ribbon from her wedding bouquet.
entries.zh: 来自明尼苏达州的信，用她婚礼花束上的丝带捆在了一起。

entries.en: Mr Bernstein carried the empty crates downstairs while his neighbours cleared the landing.
entries.zh: 伯恩斯坦先生把空木箱搬下楼时，他的邻居们正在清理楼梯平台。

entries.en: The scanned booklet occupied eighteen MB before we added the colour photographs.
entries.zh: 加入彩色照片之前，那本扫描小册子占用了十八兆字节。

entries.en: Our hosts in Canberra cleared a corner of the garage for our bicycles.
entries.zh: 我们在堪培拉借住的主人，在车库里腾了一个角落放我们的自行车。

entries.meaningZh: 赫胥黎（此处指生物学家托马斯·亨利·赫胥黎）
entries.en: The biography of Thomas Henry Huxley was shelved beside the catalogue of the biology exhibition.
entries.zh: 托马斯·亨利·赫胥黎的传记，放在生物学展览目录旁的书架上。

entries.en: We bought a second notebook in Bruges after filling the first one with drawings.
entries.zh: 第一本笔记本画满后，我们在布鲁日又买了一本。

entries.en: The parcel from Anglesey contained a knitted hat and a photograph of the family dog.
entries.zh: 来自安格尔西岛的包裹里，有一顶针织帽和一张家里那只狗的照片。

entries.en: Her old travel journal included several sketches made during a stay in Rutland.
entries.zh: 她那本旧旅行日志中，有几幅在拉特兰郡停留期间画的速写。

entries.en: The boxes from Chad reached the exhibition hall after the display cases had been assembled.
entries.zh: 来自乍得的箱子运到展厅时，展柜已经组装好了。

entries.en: Mrs Elgar brought her own sewing kit to repair the torn curtain in our hall.
entries.zh: 埃尔加太太带来自己的针线包，准备修补我们门厅里撕破的窗帘。

entries.en: The tailor reserved the last length of Saxony for a customer's winter coat.
entries.zh: 裁缝把最后一段光毛呢留给了一位顾客，用来做冬季外套。

entries.en: His photographs from Utah were still in their envelopes when we began sorting the attic.
entries.zh: 我们开始整理阁楼时，他那些来自犹他的照片还装在信封里。

entries.en: Their discussion of Jehovah in the theology seminar focused on differences between the two translations.
entries.zh: 在神学研讨课上，他们围绕耶和华展开的讨论，集中在两种译本之间的差异上。

entries.en: The address in Lawton had changed, so the parcel came back to our shop.
entries.zh: 劳顿的那个地址已经变了，因此包裹退回了我们店里。

entries.en: The museum librarian found a biography of James Hargreaves while reorganising the technology shelves.
entries.zh: 博物馆图书管理员在整理技术类书架时，找到了一本詹姆斯·哈格里夫的传记。

entries.en: We left the drawings from Monaco to dry overnight before rolling them for the journey.
entries.zh: 我们让来自摩纳哥的画晾了一夜，才把它们卷起来带上路。

entries.en: A friend in Pittsburgh offered us a spare room while we looked for a flat.
entries.zh: 我们找公寓期间，一位在匹兹堡的朋友愿意让我们住一间空房。

entries.meaningZh: 圣地亚哥（此处指智利城市）
entries.en: We stayed with friends in Santiago, Chile, while waiting for the rest of our luggage.
entries.zh: 我们在智利圣地亚哥的朋友家住着，等候其余行李运到。

entries.en: The biography of Tolstoy had a torn cover, so the librarian made a protective sleeve.
entries.zh: 那本托尔斯泰传记的封面破了，于是图书管理员给它做了一个保护套。

entries.en: In the story, a Franciscan offers the exhausted traveller a stool beside the kitchen fire.
entries.zh: 在那个故事里，一位圣方济会修道士给疲惫的旅人提供了厨房炉火旁的一张小凳子。

entries.en: The table compared the measured amounts of V in three metal samples.
entries.zh: 表格比较了三个金属样品中钒的实测含量。

entries.en: The old letters from Mongolia were stored separately from the photographs because their paper had become brittle.
entries.zh: 来自蒙古的旧信与照片分开存放，因为信纸已经变脆了。

entries.en: The historical novelist kept a portrait of Hadrian beside the drafts of her unfinished manuscript.
entries.zh: 那位历史小说家在尚未完成的书稿旁，放着一幅哈德良的肖像。

entries.meaningZh: 德国空军（此处指纳粹时代机构）
entries.en: The archive's Second World War collection included photographs of Luftwaffe aircraft with carefully recorded dates.
entries.zh: 档案馆的第二次世界大战藏品中，有一些德国空军飞机的照片，并仔细记着日期。

entries.en: The travel diary described a cancelled journey across the Mojave and the arrangements that followed.
entries.zh: 旅行日记记述了一趟被取消的莫哈韦沙漠穿越行程，以及随后作出的安排。

entries.en: The technician replaced the cracked VDU before checking the keyboard on the old computer.
entries.zh: 技术员先换掉了破裂的显示屏，然后检查那台旧电脑的键盘。

entries.en: The reviewer compared the reported IDA measurements before asking how the authors had estimated uncertainty.
entries.zh: 审稿人比较了文中报告的同位素稀释分析测量值，然后询问作者是怎样估计不确定性的。

entries.en: Hobbs kept the buttons that had fallen off in a small tin beside the ironing board.
entries.zh: 霍布斯把脱落的纽扣放在熨衣板旁的一个小铁盒里。

entries.en: We bought the sketchbook in Weimar and filled its first page with sketches on the train home.
entries.zh: 我们在魏玛买了那本速写本，并在回家的火车上画满了第一页。

entries.en: We used a separate network to test the distributed system (DS) before the demonstration.
entries.zh: 演示之前，我们用一个单独的网络测试了那个分布式系统（DS）。

entries.en: The Cypriot visitor lent us a camera after ours stopped working during the walk.
entries.zh: 散步途中，我们的相机坏了，那位塞浦路斯来客便借给我们一台。

entries.en: Her journal described a stay on Bahrain and included a sketch of the rented house.
entries.zh: 她的日志记述了在巴林岛停留的一段经历，并附有所租房子的速写。

entries.en: The theatre group discussed Socrates before choosing costumes for its fictional courtroom scene.
entries.zh: 剧团先讨论了苏格拉底，再为虚构的法庭场景挑选服装。

entries.en: The old travel journal described a winter in Bohemia through letters and unfinished sketches.
entries.zh: 那本旧旅行日志，通过书信和未完成的速写，记述了在波希米亚度过的一个冬天。

entries.en: We postponed our journey through the Pyrenees when one member of the group became ill.
entries.zh: 同行的一人生病后，我们推迟了穿越比利牛斯山脉的行程。

entries.en: The documentary about Sinatra used an old interview that the archivist had recently catalogued.
entries.zh: 那部介绍辛纳特拉的纪录片，采用了一段档案管理员最近编目的旧采访。

entries.en: The outdoor PA failed during the rehearsal, so the announcer borrowed a handheld loudspeaker.
entries.zh: 排练时，室外扩音系统出了故障，于是播报员借了一个手持扩音器。

entries.en: The child pointed to Taurus on the star chart and asked to borrow the larger telescope.
entries.zh: 那个孩子指着星图上的金牛座，问能不能借用那架更大的望远镜。

entries.en: The parcel from Oman arrived with a damaged corner, but the drawings inside were safe.
entries.zh: 来自阿曼的包裹到达时，一角已经破损，不过里面的画完好无损。

entries.en: The study group compared two translations of Jeremiah before preparing questions for the next meeting.
entries.zh: 学习小组比较了《耶利米书》的两个译本，然后为下一次聚会准备问题。

entries.en: She checked the date on the UNESCO report before adding it to her reading list.
entries.zh: 她核对了那份联合国教科文组织报告的日期，才把它加入阅读清单。

entries.en: Motherwell found the missing spectacles beneath a stack of folded towels in the cupboard.
entries.zh: 马瑟韦尔在柜子里一摞叠好的毛巾下面，找到了丢失的眼镜。

entries.en: Their old family album contained photographs taken during a rainy holiday in Powys.
entries.zh: 他们那本旧家庭相册里，有一些在波厄斯郡一个多雨的假期里拍摄的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 伯灵顿（此处指佛蒙特州城市）
entries.en: Our hosts in Burlington, Vermont, cleared a shelf for the books we had brought.
entries.zh: 我们在佛蒙特州伯灵顿借住的主人，腾出一层架子，放我们带来的书。

entries.en: The librarian repaired the torn cover of the biography of Tchaikovsky before displaying it.
entries.zh: 图书管理员先修好了那本柴可夫斯基传记破损的封面，再把它摆出来。

entries.en: Friedman brought a folding stool because he expected a long wait outside the ticket office.
entries.zh: 弗里德曼带了一把折叠凳，因为他预计要在售票处外等很久。

entries.en: In the novel, a Maya lends the visiting scholar a basket for carrying the broken pots.
entries.zh: 在那部小说里，一位马雅人把一个篮子借给来访学者，用来装破损的陶罐。

entries.en: We reached the hotel in Manila after dark and unpacked only the clothes we needed.
entries.zh: 天黑后我们才到达马尼拉的旅馆，只取出了当时需要的衣物。

entries.en: The music student borrowed a biography of Haydn to read during the long train journey.
entries.zh: 那位音乐专业学生借了一本海顿传记，打算在漫长的火车旅途中阅读。

entries.en: In the historical novel, a Corinthian offers the traveller a bed above his pottery workshop.
entries.zh: 在那部历史小说里，一位科林斯人为旅人提供了他陶器作坊楼上的一张床。

entries.en: The suitcase we bought in Pisa lost a wheel before we reached the next hotel.
entries.zh: 我们在比萨买的行李箱，还没到下一家旅馆就掉了一个轮子。

entries.en: The researcher checked the speaker's name in Hansard before completing the note beneath the photograph.
entries.zh: 研究者在英国议会议事录中核对了发言者的姓名，才写完照片下的说明。

entries.en: Wolff brought the damaged clock to our workshop wrapped in an old woollen blanket.
entries.zh: 沃尔夫用一条旧羊毛毯裹着那只坏钟，把它带到了我们的作坊。

entries.en: The student returned the biography of Christopher Marlowe with a page of handwritten notes tucked inside.
entries.zh: 那位学生归还了克里斯托弗·马洛的传记，里面还夹着一页手写笔记。

entries.en: Kaufman kept the spare light bulbs in a drawer beneath the kitchen towels.
entries.zh: 考夫曼把备用灯泡放在厨房毛巾下面的抽屉里。

entries.en: The Proust family lent us enough folding chairs to seat everyone at the garden table.
entries.zh: 普鲁斯特一家借给我们足够的折叠椅，让所有人都能坐在花园桌旁。

entries.en: In the novel's debate, a Tory disputes the proposal but agrees that the evidence deserves scrutiny.
entries.zh: 在小说中的那场辩论里，一位保守党党员反对那项提议，但同意应该仔细审查证据。

entries.en: Her paternal aunt's letters from Haiti were stored in a wooden box above the kitchen cupboard.
entries.zh: 她姑姑从海地寄来的信，收在厨房橱柜上方的一个木盒里。

entries.en: Mr Marley lent us his wheelbarrow after we explained how much soil remained to move.
entries.zh: 我们说明还有多少土要搬之后，马利先生把独轮车借给了我们。

entries.en: The travel journal included a sketch the writer made on Borneo while waiting for a delayed boat.
entries.zh: 那本旅行日志里有一幅速写，是作者在婆罗洲等候晚点的船时画的。

entries.en: We found the address in Algiers on the back of a faded family photograph.
entries.zh: 我们在一张褪色家庭照片的背面，找到了那个阿尔及尔地址。

entries.en: Brezhnev sent a new address but did not mention why the family had moved.
entries.zh: 勃列日涅夫寄来了新地址，却没有提到全家搬家的原因。

entries.en: Our friends in Sudbury sent photographs of the room they had prepared for our visit.
entries.zh: 我们在萨德伯里的朋友寄来了一些照片，拍的是为迎接我们到访而准备的房间。

entries.en: The notebook from Senegal arrived in a second parcel, separate from the framed drawings.
entries.zh: 来自塞内加尔的笔记本装在第二个包裹里运到，没有和装框的画放在一起。

entries.en: The invitation from Arkansas included a hand-drawn map and a list of nearby guesthouses.
entries.zh: 来自阿肯色州的邀请函附有一张手绘地图，以及一份附近旅馆的名单。

entries.en: We kept the letters from Cameroon in date order before lending them to the exhibition.
entries.zh: 把来自喀麦隆的信借给展览之前，我们先按日期把它们排好了。

entries.en: The photographs from Honduras were still wrapped in paper when we opened the old suitcase.
entries.zh: 我们打开那个旧行李箱时，来自洪都拉斯的照片还用纸包着。

entries.en: Her account of a stay on Nevis included a detailed drawing of the kitchen in her rented house.
entries.zh: 她对在尼维斯岛停留经历的记述中，附有一幅所租房屋厨房的详细图画。

entries.meaningZh: 奥德菲尔德（历史赛车手）
entries.en: The museum librarian set aside a biography of Barney Oldfield for the visiting researcher.
entries.zh: 博物馆图书管理员为来访研究者留出了一本巴尼·奥德菲尔德的传记。

entries.en: The ticket to Aden was tucked inside the journal, beside a sketch of the waiting room.
entries.zh: 去亚丁的票夹在日志里，旁边是一幅等候室的速写。

entries.en: The address in Hendrix was incomplete, so the letter came back to our office.
entries.zh: 那个亨德里克斯地址不完整，因此信退回了我们的办公室。

entries.en: The actor playing Orpheus waited behind the curtain while the stagehands moved the painted trees.
entries.zh: 扮演奥菲士的演员在幕布后等候时，舞台工作人员正在搬动绘制的树景。

entries.en: In the historical novel, a Cossack shares a meal with a traveller whose horse has gone lame.
entries.zh: 在那部历史小说里，一位哥萨克人与一名马瘸了的旅人共进一餐。

entries.en: The child drew Zeus above a bank of purple clouds in an invented mythological scene.
entries.zh: 那个孩子在自己编想的神话场景中，把宙斯画在一大片紫色云层上方。

entries.en: The film's Icelandic captions were too small to read from the back of the room.
entries.zh: 坐在房间后面，看不清那部影片中字号过小的冰岛语字幕。

entries.meaningZh: 系统扩充（此处指系统扩展程序）
entries.en: The test report compared memory use with and without the system extension (SE).
entries.zh: 测试报告比较了使用和不使用系统扩展程序（SE）时的内存占用情况。

entries.meaningZh: 巴伦西亚（此处指西班牙城市）
entries.en: The drawings made in Valencia, Spain, were packed separately because their ink was still wet.
entries.zh: 在西班牙巴伦西亚画的那些画分开装了，因为墨迹还没有干。

entries.en: Stravinsky returned our tent with all the pegs counted and packed together in a separate bag.
entries.zh: 斯特拉温斯基归还了我们的帐篷，所有地钉都数过，一起装在一个单独的袋子里。

entries.en: The actor playing Oedipus asked for a shorter cloak before the rehearsal began.
entries.zh: 排练开始前，扮演俄狄浦斯的演员要求换一件短些的斗篷。

entries.en: The hotel in Colombo kept our luggage while we searched for a replacement suitcase.
entries.zh: 我们寻找替换行李箱时，科伦坡的那家旅馆替我们保管了行李。

entries.en: The notebook from Laos had a water-stained cover but no damaged pages inside.
entries.zh: 那本来自老挝的笔记本封面有水渍，不过里面的书页没有损坏。

entries.meaningZh: 印欧语系语言的（旧时用语）
entries.en: She compared Aryan verb endings in an old grammar, noting that its terminology was obsolete.
entries.zh: 她比较了一本旧语法书中的印欧语系语言动词词尾，并指出书中的术语已经过时。

entries.en: We left Mannheim with a broken umbrella and a notebook full of unfinished drawings.
entries.zh: 我们离开曼海姆时，带着一把坏雨伞，以及一本满是未完成图画的笔记本。

entries.en: The review compared methods used to measure neomycin (NM) residues in archived samples.
entries.zh: 那篇综述比较了用于测量存档样品中新霉素（NM）残留量的方法。

entries.en: Wittgenstein brought enough spare fabric to replace the torn lining in both coats.
entries.zh: 维特根斯坦带来了足够的备用布料，可以换掉两件外套撕破的衬里。

entries.en: In the historical novel, a Jacobite hides a letter inside the lining of a borrowed coat.
entries.zh: 在那部历史小说里，一位詹姆斯二世的追随者把信藏进了借来的外套衬里。

entries.en: The parcel from Waterford contained the missing sketchbook and a neatly folded apology.
entries.zh: 来自沃特福德的包裹里，有那本遗失的速写本和一封叠得整齐的道歉信。

entries.en: Steiner repaired the loose shelf before putting the heavier books back in place.
entries.zh: 斯坦纳修好了松动的架子，才把较重的书放回原处。

entries.en: Mrs Piaget brought a spare coat for the child who had forgotten his own.
entries.zh: 皮亚杰太太带来了一件备用外套，给那个忘带自己外套的男孩穿。

entries.en: The invitation from Liberia arrived after our friends had already left on their journey.
entries.zh: 来自利比里亚的邀请到达时，我们的朋友们已经出发了。

entries.en: The course on Hinduism began with a discussion of how to compare translations responsibly.
entries.zh: 那门印度教课程先讨论了怎样审慎地比较不同译本。

entries.en: We reached Marseille late and carried our wet luggage straight to the rented room.
entries.zh: 我们很晚才到马赛，随即把湿行李搬进了租来的房间。

entries.en: The student revised the section about life during the Jurassic after reading her tutor's comments.
entries.zh: 读过导师的评语后，那位学生修改了有关侏罗纪生命的部分。

entries.en: Khomeini lent us a folding ladder so that we could repair the curtain rail.
entries.zh: 霍梅尼借给我们一把折叠梯，好让我们修理窗帘轨道。

entries.en: Britten packed the fragile bowls between layers of newspaper before loading the van.
entries.zh: 布里顿把易碎的碗夹在几层报纸之间包好，然后才往货车上装。

entries.en: Susanna brought a spare umbrella because the children had left theirs at school.
entries.zh: 苏珊娜带来了一把备用雨伞，因为孩子们把自己的伞落在了学校。

entries.en: The students used dynamic programming (DP) to compare possible schedules for their fictional delivery service.
entries.zh: 学生们用动态规划（DP），比较了虚构配送服务的几种可能排程。

entries.en: The photographs from Mali were kept beside the diary in a waterproof folder.
entries.zh: 来自马里的照片与日记一起，收在一个防水文件夹里。

entries.en: Her journal described a delayed departure from Timor and the extra night spent packing.
entries.zh: 她的日志记述了离开帝汶岛的行程被推迟，以及多出来那个晚上整理行李的经历。

entries.en: The Latvian visitor brought her sketchbook to the workshop but left her paints at the hotel.
entries.zh: 那位拉脱维亚来客带了速写本参加工作坊，却把颜料留在了旅馆。

entries.en: A torn portrait of Otto von Bismarck lay between two blank pages in the collector's album.
entries.zh: 收藏家的相册里，两张空白页之间夹着一幅撕破的奥托·冯·俾斯麦肖像。

entries.en: The researcher borrowed a biography of Douglas MacArthur before preparing questions for the archive visit.
entries.zh: 那位研究者先借了一本道格拉斯·麦克阿瑟的传记，再为参观档案馆准备问题。

entries.meaningZh: 希拉里（此处指希拉里·克林顿）
entries.en: We compared an archived interview with Hillary Clinton against the transcript before cataloguing the recording.
entries.zh: 我们把一段希拉里·克林顿的存档采访与文字稿作了核对，然后才给那段录音编目。

entries.en: Our friends in Slovakia sent photographs of the bookshelves they had built for the spare room.
entries.zh: 我们在斯洛伐克的朋友寄来了一些照片，拍的是他们为备用房间搭的书架。

entries.en: The return ticket to Tewkesbury was tucked beneath the loose lining of her handbag.
entries.zh: 回图克斯伯里的票，塞在她手提包松动的衬里下面。

entries.en: Her paternal grandmother read the letter aloud in Yiddish before explaining the family joke.
entries.zh: 她祖母先用意第绪语朗读了那封信，然后解释了那个家人之间的笑话。

entries.en: The actor playing Othello waited for the stagehands to finish moving the heavy curtain.
entries.zh: 扮演奥赛罗的演员等着舞台工作人员搬完那幅厚重的幕布。

entries.meaningZh: 一六零五（有机磷杀虫药）
entries.en: The research team compared old measurements of PAC residues from several abandoned storage sites.
entries.zh: 研究小组比较了几处废弃储存地点过去测得的一六零五（PAC）残留量。

entries.en: The report gave the aircraft's speed in Mach, with a separate column for measurement uncertainty.
entries.zh: 报告以马赫数表示飞机的速度，并另列一栏说明测量不确定性。

entries.en: We bought a replacement umbrella in Tivoli after the wind broke the old one.
entries.zh: 风把旧雨伞吹坏后，我们在蒂沃利买了一把替换的伞。

entries.en: Carew returned the borrowed suitcase with its broken handle carefully repaired and wrapped in cloth.
entries.zh: 卡鲁归还了借来的行李箱，坏掉的把手已仔细修好，还用布包着。

entries.en: Her note was dated 14 Sep, but the envelope carried a later postmark.
entries.zh: 她便条上写的日期是九月十四日，不过信封上的邮戳日期更晚。

entries.en: In the historical novel, a Czechoslovak lends the traveller a bicycle for the final part of the journey.
entries.zh: 在那部历史小说里，一位捷克斯洛伐克人借给旅人一辆自行车，供他走完最后一段路。

entries.en: The package from Montenegro contained two sketchbooks and a scarf wrapped around a broken camera.
entries.zh: 来自黑山的包裹里，有两本速写本，还有一条围着坏相机的围巾。

entries.en: The address in Teheran was written inside the notebook, beneath a drawing of the front door.
entries.zh: 那个德黑兰地址写在笔记本里，就在一幅前门图画的下面。

entries.en: Her account of a stay on Islay included a drawing of the cottage where she had rented a room.
entries.zh: 她对在艾雷岛停留经历的记述中，附有一幅她租房住的那栋小屋的图画。

entries.en: The tutor asked for clearer captions beneath the diagrams showing life during the Devonian.
entries.zh: 导师要求把展示泥盆纪生命的图示下方说明写得更清楚一些。

entries.en: The student borrowed a book about Ingres to read while waiting for the evening train.
entries.zh: 那位学生借了一本介绍安格尔的书，准备在等晚班火车时阅读。

entries.meaningZh: 布鲁特斯（罗马政治人物）
entries.en: The actor playing Brutus asked for a lighter costume before the historical play's first rehearsal.
entries.zh: 那部历史剧第一次排练之前，扮演布鲁特斯的演员要求换一套轻些的服装。

entries.en: The Mubarak family lent us a large cooking pot for the neighbourhood supper.
entries.zh: 穆巴拉克一家借给我们一口大锅，用于邻里聚餐。

entries.en: The actor playing Tristram practised mounting the wooden horse before the costume rehearsal.
entries.zh: 服装排练之前，扮演崔斯特瑞姆的演员练习了登上那匹木马。

entries.en: Mrs Barth kept the spare sewing needles in a tin beneath the kitchen scales.
entries.zh: 巴斯太太把备用缝衣针收在厨房秤下面的一个铁盒里。

entries.en: The biography of Gustave Flaubert was still open on her desk when the library closed.
entries.zh: 图书馆关门时，那本古斯塔夫·福楼拜的传记还摊开在她的桌子上。

entries.en: The curator questioned the student's description of the painted decoration as Hellenistic.
entries.zh: 策展人对那位学生把彩绘装饰描述为希腊风格的说法提出了疑问。

entries.en: The letters from Mogadishu were kept in a folder separate from the travel receipts.
entries.zh: 来自摩加迪沙的信，放在一个与旅行收据分开的文件夹里。

entries.en: Her paternal aunt sent a notebook from Uzbekistan with a pressed flower inside the cover.
entries.zh: 她姑姑从乌兹别克斯坦寄来一本笔记本，封面内侧夹着一朵压干的花。

entries.en: The diary described a rainy week in Sabah and included sketches of the rented house.
entries.zh: 那本日记记述了在沙巴度过的多雨的一周，里面还有所租房屋的速写。

entries.en: The researchers compared their ELISA results with the measurements reported by the second laboratory.
entries.zh: 研究者们把自己的酶联免疫吸附测定结果，与第二家实验室报告的测量值作了比较。

entries.en: Derrida carried the empty plant pots downstairs while the neighbours cleared space on the balcony.
entries.zh: 德里达把空花盆搬下楼时，邻居们正在阳台上腾地方。

entries.en: The researcher compared old newspaper reports about Hezbollah before checking their dates and sources.
entries.zh: 那位研究者比较了有关真主党的旧报纸报道，然后核查它们的日期和来源。

entries.en: We postponed the visit to Knossos because the drawings from the previous day were still wet.
entries.zh: 前一天的画还没干，因此我们推迟了去克诺索斯的行程。

entries.meaningZh: 陀斯妥也夫斯基（小说家）
entries.en: The biography of Dostoevsky was returned with a railway ticket tucked between its final pages.
entries.zh: 那本陀斯妥也夫斯基传记归还时，最后几页之间夹着一张火车票。

entries.en: The old payroll program was written in COBOL, so we started looking for someone who could read it.
entries.zh: 那个旧工资程序是用COBOL编写的，因此我们开始寻找能看懂它的人。
